rationale: The batch repeatedly has a low-probability noun target “day” immediately after the phrase “On a sunny”; the representative error shows the model favoring punctuation and other continuations instead. Add a rule to the existing day root for this visible suffix, rather than changing general noun or story-framing behavior. This should also help other occurrences of the same phrase in the batch. The rule is intentionally narrow: it will not help other adjective–noun sequences, and it could overfavor “day” if the phrase occurs in a context where another continuation is intended. The batch includes many other valid noun continuations, so no broader claim that other candidates are impossible is warranted. This is a provisional repair; replay behavior and the gate still need to be checked.
